description: Product-neutral per-round falsification objectives for the independent campaign audit. Each audit round is assigned one objective (round r uses objectives[(r-1) mod N]) and the audit report cannot pass without machine receipt categories specific to that objective. Replaying the same generic receipt suite cannot satisfy every round: each objective requires its own receipt categories.

objectives.label: Runner capability falsification
objectives.rationale: Challenge the claim that declared runner capabilities and the project verification gate really ran at the audited commit.

objectives.label: Visual and installed acceptance falsification
objectives.rationale: Challenge whether the installed product and its visual output are real acceptance rather than offscreen or source-tree proxies.

objectives.label: Real system/service falsification
objectives.rationale: Challenge whether an adopter-declared real system service and independent external observer were exercised through the production path.

objectives.label: Package and namespace falsification
objectives.rationale: Challenge the packaged artifact namespace, build, and install layout claims.

objectives.label: Final evidence and definition-of-done falsification
objectives.rationale: Challenge the final gate run and the audit report itself as durable evidence of the completion claim.
